title: Certify v0.14.0: documentation-correction round — every released part's prose re-derived against its own artifacts
description: This release corrects the documentation of all thirteen parts of the Certify corpus. No certificate, checker, or certified value changes; every checker in the repository passes as before, and every mathematical result of Parts A through M stands unaltered. What changed is prose: artifact inventories that listed files the deposit does not contain, replay instructions that did not run as written, counts and labels contradicted by the shipped artifacts, and several claims that the artifacts refute. The round was produced by a retroactive cross-examination of every build-log decision against the prose of its own paper, followed by a re-derivation pass in which each checkable sentence was re-executed against the artifact rather than re-read, and an independent referee pass by a session that did no editing. Among the corrections: a Part A erratum-check script queried the wrong rational point and so appeared to refute the erratum it supports; a Part B quickstart carried a decompression command that would have destroyed three shipped proof archives; a Part H count of uncorrectable fault sets was unqualified by its weight bound; a Part J invariant table was described as separating thirteen graphs it does not separate; Part L's coverage and gold-value anchor claims were restated; and a Part M zero-field curvature claim was corrected, four of the ten published points being certified local minima rather than saddles. A CORRECTIONS.md index lists every corrected claim by part with its replacement. The correction procedure and the gates now standing between a claim and the public record are recorded in the repository's protocol. Computations carried out with Claude (Anthropic), directed by the author.
